text:
A current-carrying coil in the magnetic field between the poles of two magnets experiences a
turning effect.
Which change would decrease the turning effect?
A
decreasing the distance between the magnets
B
increasing the current in the coil
C
using stronger magnets
D
decreasing the number of turns on the coil

options.label: A
options.text: decreasing the distance between the magnets

options.label: B
options.text: increasing the current in the coil

options.label: D
options.text: decreasing the number of turns on the coil
